react_result.final_narrative_text: The differentially abundant metabolite set is dominated by eicosanoids derived from arachidonic acid (KEGG:C00219), producing a convergent signal across four independent analysis paradigms: RaMP multi-DB ORA (FDR=9.2e-18), MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA (p=7.5e-08), and Mummichog m/z-direct activity (p=4.2e-04). Arachidonic acid itself is the upstream substrate and canonical driver, giving rise to three downstream branches detected in the data: (i) the 5-lipoxygenase (5-LOX) branch producing 5-HETE (C04805) and leukotriene A4 (C00909), (ii) the cytochrome-P450 branch producing 15-HETE (C04742) and 11,12,15-THETA (C14782), and (iii) the cyclooxygenase (COX) branch producing 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-prostaglandin J2 (C14717). Arachidonic acid and its eicosanoid products are canonical mediators of inflammation, pain, and cell proliferation signalling; coordinated elevation across all three branches is consistent with an acute or chronic inflammatory stimulus in the treatment group. CDP (C00112) appears only in the Mummichog N-glycan and pyrimidine metabolism modules, representing an independent metabolic perturbation unrelated to the arachidonic acid cascade.

final_react_result.final_narrative_text: The differentially abundant metabolite set is dominated by eicosanoids derived from arachidonic acid (KEGG:C00219), producing a convergent signal across four independent analysis paradigms: RaMP multi-DB ORA (FDR=9.2e-18), MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA (p=7.5e-08), and Mummichog m/z-direct activity (p=4.2e-04). Arachidonic acid itself is the upstream substrate and canonical driver, giving rise to three downstream branches detected in the data: (i) the 5-lipoxygenase (5-LOX) branch producing 5-HETE (C04805) and leukotriene A4 (C00909), (ii) the cytochrome-P450 branch producing 15-HETE (C04742) and 11,12,15-THETA (C14782), and (iii) the cyclooxygenase (COX) branch producing 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-prostaglandin J2 (C14717). Arachidonic acid and its eicosanoid products are canonical mediators of inflammation, pain, and cell proliferation signalling; coordinated elevation across all three branches is consistent with an acute or chronic inflammatory stimulus in the treatment group. CDP (C00112) appears only in the Mummichog N-glycan and pyrimidine metabolism modules, representing an independent metabolic perturbation unrelated to the arachidonic acid cascade.
